concept.subject: Natural stone arch bridges on two tiers spanning a steaming canyon in the highlands.
concept.composition: A row of four round arches on thick pillars crosses the whole picture with the arches' tops at three fifths of the height; on each side of the open top center an upper tier of two smaller arches stands at a third of the height. Steam rises from the canyon floor between the pillars, small lanterns hang under the arches, and sandstone ledges step down along both side edges.
concept.layout: 43 round pegs and 135 bricks. The architecture template's colonnade builds the arches and the pillars on two tiers from bricks; the sandstone ledges at the sides are brick slides that lean inward. Pegs mark the steam plumes rising between the pillars and the lanterns under the arches.

difficulty.note: The stage opener and its easiest level: the arches' tops shed balls into the open spans between the pillars.

background.prompt: A deep canyon in a volcanic highland under a hazy pale-gold sky, spanned by natural stone bridges. A row of four round stone arches on thick pillars crosses the whole picture, the arches' tops at about three fifths of the picture height; above it, on each side of the open top center, an upper tier of two smaller arches stands at about one third of the height. The stone is soft blue-gray basalt and warm sandstone. Thin plumes of pale steam rise from the canyon floor between the pillars, and a few small lanterns with tiny ember-colored flames hang under the arches. Sandstone ledges step down along both side edges; a smoking volcano stands far off in the haze; the lower corners are plain rock.

picture.title: Scenic view of Mesa Arch framing distant rock formations in Canyonlands National Park, Utah.
picture.author: Ronapei
